footer.tagline: A homestay in Saku, Nagano: a private room in a home where the host lives.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for may have moved or been removed, or the URL may be wrong.

home.registerBody: Please register every guest before check-in.

guest.hasJapanAddress: Do you have an address in Japan?
guest.passportHelp: Guests without an address in Japan must enter their nationality and passport number.
guest.passportPrivacy: Passport numbers are stored encrypted, and only the last 4 characters are ever shown.

validation.tooManyGuests: You entered more guests than the planned number of guests
validation.representativeExactlyOne: Exactly one guest must be the representative
validation.summaryCount: {count, plural, one {# field needs} other {# fields need}} attention.

errors.validation_error: Some entries are invalid. Please check each field.
errors.facility_unavailable: This property is not accepting registrations right now.
errors.capacity_exceeded: This exceeds the property's capacity. Check the number of guests or contact the host.
errors.idempotency_conflict: This registration has already been submitted. Please contact the host.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.token_invalid: This edit link is not valid. Please ask the host for a new one.
errors.token_expired: This edit link has expired. Please contact the host.
errors.field_not_editable: This item cannot be changed with the edit link. Please contact the host.
errors.precondition_failed: This registration was updated elsewhere, so we loaded the latest version. Please try again.
errors.network_error: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.internal_error: A server error occurred. Please try again later.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

status.incomplete: Some guests are not registered yet

registration.title: Guest registration
registration.intro: Please register the representative and the other guests before check-in. The host checks identity in person at check-in.

stay.maxGuests: Up to {count, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}}

representative.description: Enter the details of the guest who represents the group.

companions.description: Enter the other guests. You can register now even if some are missing and add them later with the edit link.
companions.limitReached: You have entered the planned number of guests.
companions.sameAsRepresentative: Use the representative's address and phone
companions.copyNotice: Only the address and phone are copied. Each guest enters their own nationality and passport number.

review.description: Check your entries, give your consent and register.
review.privacyLabel: I agree to the Privacy Policy (version {version})

registration.partialWarning: You are registering {registered} of {planned} planned guests. Add the remaining {remaining} with the edit link shown after you register.
registration.alreadySubmittedBody: We have already received this registration. If you need an edit link, please contact the host.
registration.networkError: Could not connect. Your entries are kept; please press "Register" again.

complete.title: Registration received
complete.lead: Thank you for registering. The host checks identity in person at check-in.
complete.editLinkBody: Use this link to add guests or correct some details. Valid until {expiresAt} (end of the check-out day).
complete.keepSafe: This link is for you only. Do not share it or post it online. Save it as a bookmark or note.
complete.noResultBody: The edit link cannot be shown again, for example because the page was reloaded. If you registered and need the link, ask the host to reissue it.

manage.title: Review and correct your registration
manage.representativeReadOnly: The representative's details cannot be changed with this link. Please contact the host.
manage.editGuestHelp: Fill in only what you want to change. Empty fields stay as they are.
manage.editStayHelp: Clearing an optional field removes it. To change dates, contact the host.
manage.addHelp: You can add up to {remaining, plural, one {# more guest} other {# more guests}}.
manage.full: All planned guests are registered. To add more, first correct the planned number of guests.
manage.finishedBody: To edit again, open your saved edit link.
manage.sessionLostBody: This tab is not ready for editing. Open your saved edit link again. If you lost it, ask the host to reissue it.
manage.invalidBody: This edit link can no longer be used (for example, the host issued a new one). Ask the host for a new link.
manage.expiredBody: The editing period (end of the check-out day) has passed. Contact the host if something needs correcting.

publicSite.placeholderBody: This page has placeholder content. It will be replaced with confirmed information before launch. All photos are placeholder images.
publicSite.bookingBody: Check prices and availability on the Airbnb listing.
publicSite.ratesCaption: Indicative rates (Airbnb sets the actual price)
publicSite.surveyBody: A short anonymous survey that helps us improve.

survey.title: Post-stay survey
survey.intro: Thank you for staying with us. Please share your impressions; it takes 2–3 minutes.
survey.anonymity: This survey is anonymous. It is not linked to your registration or booking, and only the date of your answer is recorded.
survey.textHelp: Please do not include anything that identifies you (such as your name or contact details).
survey.thanksBody: Your answers help us improve the stay for future guests.
survey.errorTitle: We could not send your answers
